comparison.objective: Hold an acrylic sheet down while peeling its protective film into a basket; candidate breaks and contains tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Pinching a tab and regulating peel direction and support force versus coaxial rigid-tool alignment, hammer impact, withdrawal, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Film fully removed and discarded without tab tear or sheet lift versus four fractures and four contained tangs without coil or shell displacement.
comparison.reason: Although both need asymmetric bimanual force control and containment, peeling an extended flexible layer is a different central mechanism from rigid notch fracture. No separate spec versions were provided.
